changes: Added tenant-scoped GET /api/v1/warehouse/reservations with reservation line IDs and remaining quantities, enabling the shipment UI/client to retrieve exact reservation_line_id values for partial shipments.

Added read-only ETP platform registry API for B2B-Center, RTS-Tender, Fabrikant, Sber A and TEK-Torg; clearly reports all connectors as planned/unverified and refuses connection attempts until official API and contractual permissions are verified.
Added ETP connector architecture, security, tenant isolation, idempotency, retry, audit and acceptance requirements.
Added same-company delivery estimate association to warehouse shipments, planned cost snapshot, actual delivery cost capture, variance calculation and audit events.

Hardened frontend token handling: bearer token now remains memory-only and is not written to localStorage/sessionStorage; a page refresh requires sign-in again until secure HttpOnly session support is implemented.
Completed shipment logistics screen: list shipments, display planned/actual delivery costs, enter actual cost and refresh variance data.
Fixed delivery estimate ID retention after calculation and corrected a literal escaped newline in the TypeScript type declarations.
Corrected release QA runner so operation-control unit tests execute without requiring psycopg; PostgreSQL-only RLS tests remain explicitly gated.
Added explicit release blocker register and QA reporting for missing frontend lockfile and unavailable Docker/PostgreSQL runtime.
Fixed JSX syntax error in shipment delivery history UI; syntax-only compiler pass confirmed, full typecheck/build still blocked by missing npm dependencies.

Added browser session endpoints using HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookies, Secure in production, CSRF double-submit validation and Origin allowlist checks; retained legacy bearer endpoints for API clients.
Migrated browser UI to cookie sessions with credentials: include and CSRF header; browser code no longer receives or stores the access JWT.
Added focused cookie/session security tests; 137 unit/static tests passed with SQLite metadata-only test configuration.
Hardened browser-session Origin enforcement for login, registration, logout and cookie-authenticated mutations; missing Origin is rejected; auth responses are no-store.
Restored cookie-authenticated UI state after page reload without persisting bearer credentials in Web Storage.
Added security tests for missing/untrusted Origin and allowlist acceptance.
Required allowlisted Origin for cookie login, company registration, logout and all cookie-authenticated mutations; auth responses are no-store.
Frontend restores cookie session after page reload and keeps access token out of local/session storage.
Added regression tests for missing Origin, untrusted Origin and allowed Origin; release QA: 140 passed across 39 files.
Added server-side revocable browser sessions: unique JWT JTI registry, per-request active-session validation, current-session logout revocation and logout-all endpoint.

Added POST /api/v1/auth/session/logout-all and a browser UI action to revoke every active browser session for the signed-in user; endpoint requires current active server-side session, CSRF and allowlisted Origin.
Added regression tests for unique session JTIs, server-side persistence and expiry; QA runner reports 142 passing tests across 40 files.

Added persistent login failure throttling to bearer and cookie login: 8 failures per normalized email or 30 per IP in 15 minutes; stores only HMAC-SHA256 identifier digests; migration 0026 and regression tests.

QA v0.13: 148 tests passed across 41 selected test files; 120 Python files compile-checked; static audit passed; PostgreSQL integration, frontend production build and Docker runtime remain unexecuted.
Added authenticated-user-scoped browser session inventory and individual session revocation with CSRF and Origin validation; stores bounded User-Agent metadata only, exposes no tokens.

QA v0.16: 152 tests passed across 42 selected test files; 122 Python files compile-checked; static audit passed; PostgreSQL integration, frontend production build and Docker runtime remain unexecuted. Static audit was corrected so browser session checks execute before PASS/FAIL.

Added first tenant-scoped tender register backend: create/list/read/update endpoints, platform+number uniqueness, same-company responsible membership validation, audit events, RBAC, PostgreSQL FORCE RLS and migration 0028. Added schema, migration, router, and six regression/contract tests.
Added tenant-scoped tender positions with item name, specification, fractional quantity, unit, estimated unit price and notes.
Added composite same-company tender-position foreign key, unique line numbering, PostgreSQL RLS policy and CRUD API with audit events.
Added tender detail UI to list and add tender positions; estimated line total is explicitly indicative.
Added tenant-scoped tender positions with item name, specification, fractional quantity, unit, estimated unit price and notes.
Added migration 0029 with composite same-company tender foreign key, unique line number, nonnegative price/positive quantity constraints and FORCE RLS policy.
Added GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE tender position API endpoints with company scope, role restrictions and audit events.
Added tender detail UI for viewing and adding positions; estimated line total is marked as indicative.

Fixed unreachable tender pricing-version gates in release_audit.py; added regression tests proving every gate runs before the final exit. Updated QA runner, release version and pilot UI banner to 0.21.

Corrected browser logout/logout-all handling: only clear local authenticated state after a successful server response; failed revocation leaves the session UI visible and reports the error. Added release-audit gates and regression test.
Added optional tender_id and tender_position_id references to supplier RFQ lines, preserving compatibility for RFQs created independently of tenders.
Added same-company composite foreign key from RFQ lines to tender positions, pair check constraint, matching unique key, and migration 0031.
RFQ creation validates the linked tender position belongs to the current company and specified tender; RFQ detail returns source tender and position references.
Restored ORM models for processing_jobs, processing_operations and processing_materials to match migration 0017 and complete shared SQLAlchemy metadata.
Verified SQLite Base.metadata.create_all creates all 43 registered tables; this is not a substitute for PostgreSQL migration/RLS runtime tests.
Pilot v0.25: synchronized API/frontend/UI/QA release markers and added regression tests that verify release manifest consistency and prohibit false production-ready claims.

Added GitHub Actions release gate for PostgreSQL 16 migrations and RLS tests, reproducible frontend npm ci/build, and API/web Docker image builds; corrected frontend Docker build context contract and documented RC1 acceptance gates.
RC1 hardening: added PostgreSQL RLS matrix test for every company_id table; migration double-upgrade check; Docker Compose API/web health smoke test; updated workflow contract tests and QA manifest.

RC1 hardening: dependency vulnerability audits in CI, persisted QA evidence artifact, real disposable database and document backup/restore drill, Docker build-context secret exclusions, corrected gitignore and backup archive path.

Further RC1 hardening: Python and npm dependency audits, persisted QA artifact, disposable backup/restore verification in CI, Docker build-context exclusions, corrected .gitignore, fixed document archive path, explicit tar dependency and strict restored Alembic-head verification.

PostgreSQL privilege hardening: split bootstrap admin, non-superuser schema owner and runtime roles; run Alembic as potok_owner; added legacy pilot-volume role migration and CI assertions for role flags and table ownership.

Runtime secret isolation: moved PostgreSQL admin bootstrap and schema migrations into separate one-shot Compose jobs; API container now receives only the potok_runtime database URL. First-director creation runs in a one-off bootstrap container.

Privileged database tasks moved into separate short-lived db-bootstrap and db-migrate Compose jobs. API container now receives only runtime DATABASE_URL and JWT secret; first-director bootstrap is run in a one-off container with temporary admin credential injection. Startup waits for and removes completed privileged job containers.

Separated PostgreSQL startup into db-bootstrap (admin), db-migrate (non-superuser schema owner) and API (runtime-only credentials); removed completed secret-bearing job containers after startup; moved first-director bootstrap to a one-shot db-bootstrap command.
Raised pinned frontend Vite from 6.0.5 to 6.4.5 after npm audit identified the vulnerable Vite/esbuild dependency chain; CI npm audit and production build passed using a temporary lockfile candidate.
